contests.title: Swallow School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote: Shall the annual budget of the Swallow School District, Waukesha County, Wisconsin, be authorized to exceed the statutory revenue limit by $500,000 per year beginning with the 2026-2027 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of funding operational expenses and current educational programs?

contests.title: Oconomowoc Area School District — Ongoing revenue-limit increases

provenance.quote: Shall the Oconomowoc Area School District, Waukesha, Jefferson and Dodge Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $3,000,000 for the 2027-2028 school year; by an additional $2,000,000 (for a total of $5,000,000) for the 2028-2029 school year; by an additional $2,000,000 (for a total of $7,000,000) for the 2029-2030 school year; by an additional $2,500,000 (for a total of $9,500,000) for the 2030-2031 school year; and by an additional $2,700,000 for the 2031-2032 school year (for a total of $12,200,000 and to remain at that amount thereafter), for recurring purposes consisting of operational and maintenance expenses?

contests.title: Palmyra-Eagle Area School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote: Shall the Palmyra-Eagle Area School District, located in Waukesha, Jefferson and Walworth Counties, Wisconsin, be authorized to exceed the revenue limit specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $797,000 per year for four years, beginning with the 2027-2028 school year and ending with the 2030-2031 school year, for non-recurring purposes consisting of operational expenses , including but not limited to maintaining programs and staffing?

contests.title: Viroqua Area School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote:

contests.title: Westby Area School District — Temporary revenue-limit increase

provenance.quote:
Shall the Westby Area School District, Vernon, La Crosse and 
Monroe Counties, Wisconsin be authorized to exceed the revenue limit 
specified in Section 121.91, Wisconsin Statutes, by $1,600,000 for the

by $1,800,000 for the 2029-2030 school year, for non-recurring purposes to 
sustain educational programs and to operate the District?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $500,000 a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for five school years, from 2026–27 through 2030–31, for school operations and current educational programs. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise additional money above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for operations and maintenance. The annual amounts would be $3 million in 2027–28, $5 million in 2028–29, $7 million in 2029–30, $9.5 million in 2030–31 and $12.2 million in 2031–32. The $12.2 million annual authorization would continue after that, with no scheduled end in the question.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve these phased, ongoing revenue-limit increases.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Allows the district to raise $797,000 a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for four school years, from 2027–28 through 2030–31, for operating expenses, including maintaining programs and staffing. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise $1.8 million a year above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for four school years, from 2027–28 through 2030–31, for district operations and maintenance. The authorization ends after those years.

Allows the district to raise additional money above Wisconsin’s revenue limit for three school years: $1.6 million in 2027–28, $1.7 million in 2028–29 and $1.8 million in 2029–30. It would sustain educational programs and district operations. The authorization ends after 2029–30.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Approve these revenue-limit increases for the three listed school years.
